text:
Marina: Heads-up — planning maintenance window for apac1 next Tue 03:00–07:00 UTC. Scope: NIC firmware update on border hosts, GPU microcode patch, rolling node reboots. Need drain strategy, cross-region backfill plan, and customer comms.
Ash: How much capacity will this touch? nodes/racks?
Marina: ~120 GPU nodes across 2 racks (pool: apac1-gpu-pool-primary). 30 border hosts for NIC updates. Impact: hosted API routing + Dedicated pools if we pull too many spares.
Praveen: We can overflow to eu-west, but will incur egress + latency. Need estimate of GB shifted and QPS moved.
SRE-Oncall: Suggest staggered drains: 5 nodes/batch per rack, use apac1-gpu-spares to backfill. 10–15m cool-down between batches; run health checks + p95 guardrails.
Elaine: Dedicated customers require 7-day notice. Also include explicit rollback criteria in communications.
DevOps-Bot: Maintenance created: apac1-nic-gpu-smooth-2087654321 — id m-2087654321
Marina: Proposed timeline (UTC):
- 02:30: netops preflight link tests + routing sanity
- 03:00–03:45: NIC firmware on border hosts (non-GPU path)
- 03:45–06:00: GPU microcode + rolling reboots (5 nodes per batch)
- 06:00–07:00: validation, KV cache warmup, telemetry soak
Ash: If we backfill to eu-west, pre-warm models there to avoid cold startup spikes.
Praveen: Cost estimate: if we cross-transfer ~15 TB for live inference, egress ~ $0.09/GB => ~$1,350. Also expect extra instance-hours for spares during soak.
Marina: Prefer intra-region spares first; overflow to eu-west only after thresholds.
SRE-Oncall: Runbook drain snippet:
```
kubectl drain gpu-node-045 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120 --timeout=10m
kubectl label node gpu-node-045 maintenance=true
# wait for pods to reschedule, run healthcheck hook
```
Note: inhibit autoscaler for the pool during batches to avoid churn.
Elaine: Rollback triggers: error-rate > 2x baseline for 5m OR p95 up by >200ms on production routes.
Marina: I'll add rollback criteria to runbook and status entry.
Deploy-Bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/m-2087654321
Ash: apac1-gpu-spares has 28 nodes, 4 reserved for Dedicated => effective spares 24.
Praveen: Watch for RX/TX drops during NIC patch; throttle batch size if retransmits rise. Also monitor TCP retransmit and socket queue lengths.
NetOps: We'll run BGP + link-level preflight at 02:30 UTC. Will post results in channel.
Marina: Action items:
- Marina: send SLA notices to dedicated accounts today (include rollback criteria)
- Ash: prepare eu-west pre-warm scripts; flag heavy models to prefetch
- Praveen: final cost calc and egress cap plan
- NetOps: run preflight at 02:30 UTC
- SRE-Oncall: create ephemeral incident channel and enable verbose telemetry
- Elaine: update customer comms + notify account teams
I'll create incident channel and attach runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/apac1-nic-gpu-maint
SRE-Oncall: I'll be on for the full window; +1 infra. Ping @NetOps when first batch starts.
Marina: Thanks all. If no objections by EOD I'll schedule and ship notifications. :rocket:
